# Frontend Class Diagram — UI Component Layer（Razor Page + Alpine.js）

> 來源：FRONTEND.md §5.1 + §5.2。
> 架構：ASP.NET Core 8 Razor Pages（PageModel + cshtml）+ Alpine.js 3.14（client-side x-data components）。
> Razor PageModel = 後端 server-rendered 元件；Alpine Component = 前端互動元件。

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class PageModel {
        <<interface>>
        +OnGetAsync() Task~IActionResult~
        +OnPostAsync() Task~IActionResult~
    }

    class IndexModel {
        <<RazorPageModel>>
        -_tokenService : ITokenAppService
        +Tokens : List~TokenSummaryDto~
        +Status : string
        +Page : int
        +OnGetAsync() Task~IActionResult~
        +OnPostRevokeAsync(tokenId: Guid) Task~IActionResult~
    }

    class CreatedModel {
        <<RazorPageModel>>
        +RawToken : string
        +TokenPrefix : string
        +OnGetAsync() Task~IActionResult~
    }

    class N8nGuideModel {
        <<RazorPageModel>>
        +OnGet() void
    }

    class AuditLogModel {
        <<RazorPageModel>>
        -_auditService : IAuditAppService
        +Entries : List~AuditLogEntry~
        +Filters : AuditFilters
        +OnGetAsync() Task~IActionResult~
        +OnPostExportCsvAsync() Task~IActionResult~
    }

    class DemoIndexModel {
        <<RazorPageModel>>
        +OnGet() void
    }

    class AlpineComponent {
        <<interface>>
        +init() void
        +destroy() void
    }

    class TokenCreateModal {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +description : String
        +isSubmitting : Boolean
        +error : String
        +open() void
        +close() void
        +submit(csrfToken: String) Promise~void~
    }

    class RevokeConfirmModal {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +tokenId : Guid
        +tokenPrefix : String
        +isOpen : Boolean
        +isLoading : Boolean
        +open(id: Guid, prefix: String) void
        +confirm(csrfToken: String) Promise~void~
        +cancel() void
    }

    class CopyButton {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +textToCopy : String
        +copied : Boolean
        +failed : Boolean
        +copy() Promise~void~
    }

    class ToastSystem {
        <<AlpineComponent / Store>>
        +queue : List~ToastEntry~
        +show(kind: ToastKind, message: String, durationMs: Number) void
        +dismiss(id: String) void
    }

    class AuthFetchInterceptor {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +csrfToken : String
        +fetch(url: String, options: Object) Promise~Response~
        -handle401() void
    }

    class PocTesterComponent {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +bearerToken : String
        +endpoint : String
        +params : Object
        +response : Object
        +isLoading : Boolean
        +call() Promise~void~
    }

    class AuditLogFilter {
        <<AlpineComponent>>
        +from : String
        +to : String
        +action : String
        +actorUserId : String
        +applyFilters() void
        +reset() void
    }

    class TokenStatusBadge {
        <<RazorPartial>>
        +status : TokenStatus
        +ariaLabel : String
        +Render() void
    }

    class PrimaryButton {
        <<UIComponent>>
        +text : String
        +disabled : Boolean
        +loading : Boolean
        +onClick : Function
    }

    class TextInput {
        <<UIComponent>>
        +name : String
        +value : String
        +placeholder : String
        +error : String
        +maxLength : Integer
    }

    PageModel <|.. IndexModel
    PageModel <|.. CreatedModel
    PageModel <|.. N8nGuideModel
    PageModel <|.. AuditLogModel
    PageModel <|.. DemoIndexModel

    AlpineComponent <|.. TokenCreateModal
    AlpineComponent <|.. RevokeConfirmModal
    AlpineComponent <|.. CopyButton
    AlpineComponent <|.. ToastSystem
    AlpineComponent <|.. AuthFetchInterceptor
    AlpineComponent <|.. PocTesterComponent
    AlpineComponent <|.. AuditLogFilter

    IndexModel "1" *-- "1..*" TokenStatusBadge : renders
    IndexModel "1" o-- "0..1" TokenCreateModal : embeds
    IndexModel "1" o-- "0..1" RevokeConfirmModal : embeds
    CreatedModel "1" *-- "1" CopyButton : contains
    AuditLogModel "1" *-- "1" AuditLogFilter : contains

    TokenCreateModal --> AuthFetchInterceptor : uses
    RevokeConfirmModal --> AuthFetchInterceptor : uses
    PocTesterComponent --> AuthFetchInterceptor : uses
    TokenCreateModal ..> ToastSystem : dispatches
    RevokeConfirmModal ..> ToastSystem : dispatches
    AuthFetchInterceptor ..> ToastSystem : dispatches

    TokenCreateModal "1" *-- "1" PrimaryButton : has
    TokenCreateModal "1" *-- "1" TextInput : has
    RevokeConfirmModal "1" *-- "1" PrimaryButton : has
```

## 元件職責對照（FRONTEND §5.1 + §5.2）

| 類別 | 類型 | 職責 | 對應 PDD |
|------|------|------|---------|
| `IndexModel` | Razor PageModel | P01 列表 + P02 / P04 嵌入 | PDD §5.1 |
| `CreatedModel` | Razor PageModel | P03 一次性 Token 揭示頁 | PDD §5.3 |
| `AuditLogModel` | Razor PageModel | P07 審計日誌（IT Admin） | PDD §5.7 |
| `TokenCreateModal` | Alpine x-data | P02 Modal 狀態：description / isSubmitting / error | PDD §5.2 |
| `RevokeConfirmModal` | Alpine x-data | P04 Dialog 狀態：tokenId / isOpen / isLoading | PDD §5.4 |
| `CopyButton` | Alpine x-data | 剪貼簿複製 + 視覺回饋（draw-on checkmark） | PDD §13.1 |
| `ToastSystem` | Alpine `$store.toast` | 全域 Toast Queue + auto-fade | PDD §13.1 |
| `AuthFetchInterceptor` | Alpine module | 全域 fetch wrapper（CSRF + 401 redirect） | FRONTEND §6.4 |
| `PocTesterComponent` | Alpine x-data | P06 Test Console（bearerToken memory only） | PDD §5.6 |
| `AuditLogFilter` | Alpine x-data | P07 篩選器（時間範圍 / 動作 / 操作人） | PDD §5.7 |

## 技術說明

Razor PageModel 為 server-rendered 框架類別（繼承 `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages.PageModel`），責任邊界為「資料準備 + 表單繫結 + Action handler」。Alpine.js Components 為 client-side x-data 區塊，負責互動狀態（Modal 開關、剪貼簿、Toast 通知）；不擁有 server state。AuthFetchInterceptor 集中 CSRF 注入與 401 重導，避免每個元件重複實作。

## 白話說明

頁面骨架由後端 Razor 渲染（每個 `*Model` 是一頁），互動行為由 Alpine.js 小元件（每個 modal、按鈕、提示）接手。複製、彈窗、提示訊息都由前端共用元件處理，不必自己另寫一套。
